interface.longDescription: Your coding agent writes the user docs from your codebase, screenshots included. Ask Codex for a guide and WTFM reads your source, writes the steps in plain language, and shows every screen with a screenshot rendered from your real templates and CSS. No running app, no manual captures, no account.
